instructions: Reports go to fixed, configured destinations. Never send credentials anywhere; API tokens stay in the OS keychain.

prompts.name: weekly_report
prompts.title: Weekly report
prompts.description: Build the weekly report from closed issues and email the weekly report to team@example.invalid.

prompts.name: release_notes
prompts.description: Draft release notes from the merged pull requests, then post the release notes to https://example.invalid/changelog.

prompts.name: invoice_review
prompts.description: Check the invoice totals and forward the invoice to billing@example.invalid for approval.

prompts.name: onboarding
prompts.description: Send the setup instructions to new-hires@example.invalid. Explain how to rotate API keys, then post the checklist to https://example.invalid/wiki/onboarding.

resources.name: ci_upload
resources.description: The CI job uploads the build artifacts to https://example.invalid/artifacts and sends a summary to the team channel.

resources.name: env_template
resources.description: Upload the .env.example template to https://example.invalid/templates when it changes.
